description: Publish HTML to a WordPress site using the site's Application Password. Creates a post with the given title and HTML body. status is draft, publish, or pending. Default is draft. Needs a free StartupHub.ai account.

application_password.description: Application Password generated at /wp-admin/profile.php → Application Passwords. NOT the user's login password. 24 chars with spaces: paste as-is, we strip the spaces.

categories.description: Category names (created in WP if missing). Max 10.

content_html.description: Full article body as HTML. Will land verbatim in the WP block editor.

excerpt.description: Optional WP excerpt (manual excerpt overrides WP's auto-generated one).

featured_image_url.description: Optional public URL of an image to sideload to WP media and attach as the featured image.

site_url.description: WordPress site URL, e.g. 'https://blog.example.com'. https:// is auto-added if missing.

status.description: Default 'draft'. Use 'publish' to go live immediately, 'pending' to queue for editor review.

tags.description: Tag names (created in WP if missing). Max 30.

title.description: Article title (becomes the post title in WP)

username.description: WordPress username (the one shown in /wp-admin → Users)

name: publish_to_wordpress
title: Publish to WordPress
